events.help: The appointments of the project. The end of an appointment is computed from start and duration and is held in no field. When reading, only their extent is delivered unless this field is requested explicitly.

id.help: The identifier of the appointment; the app assigns it on creation. Use it to address the appointment when changing or deleting.

title.help: The label of the appointment. It must not be empty; spaces at the edges are removed.

date.help: The day of the appointment as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-03-14; it must be a real calendar date.

time.help: The start of the appointment as HH:MM on a 5-minute grid, between 00:00 and 23:55; 09:00 when not given.

duration.help: The duration in whole minutes, at least 5; 60 when not given. In the dialog it results from end minus start and is only displayed.

desc.help: A description of the appointment as free text; empty when not given.

phase.help: The phase the appointment is coloured by. Any phase of any cycle is valid; when not given, the first phase of the active cycle. An appointment from another cycle keeps its phase — the dialog offers it as an extra choice “Phase (cycle)”.

source.help: Where the appointment comes from. Only appointments from the task list carry the value todo; change them there, because the next report from the task list replaces them.

viewMode.help: The calendar view: month or week. The choice is saved with the project.

axisFrom.help: The first hour shown on the day axis, 0 to 23. It must come before the last and only bounds the week view, not the appointments.

axisTo.help: The last hour shown on the day axis, 1 to 24. It must come after the first and only bounds the week view, not the appointments.

dayFrom.help: The first weekday shown, Monday to Sunday. It must not come after the last.

dayTo.help: The last weekday shown, Monday to Sunday. It must not come before the first.

addEvent.help: Adds an appointment and returns its id.

params.title: The label; spaces at the edges are removed. An empty text is an error.
params.date: The day as YYYY-MM-DD; a date that does not exist (such as 2026-02-30) is an error.
params.time: The start as HH:MM on a 5-minute grid; 09:00 when not given. A time off the grid is an error.
params.duration: The duration in whole minutes, at least 5; 60 when not given.
params.desc: The description; empty when not given.
params.phase: The phase of the appointment; any phase of any cycle is valid, when not given the first phase of the active cycle.

updateEvent.help: Changes the supplied entries of an appointment; the others stay as they are.

params.id: The id of the appointment as read() lists it under events. An unknown id is an error.
params.title: The new label; spaces at the edges are removed. An empty text is an error.
params.time: The new start as HH:MM on a 5-minute grid.
params.duration: The new duration in whole minutes, at least 5.
params.phase: The new phase; any phase of any cycle is valid.

removeEvent.help: Removes an appointment. In the interface the calendar asks first.

params.id: The id of the appointment as read() lists it under events. An unknown id is an error.

end.help: The end of the appointment as HH:MM. It must come after the start; the duration is end minus start.

topN.help: How many upcoming appointments the tile shows at most, from 1 to 10.

horizon.help: How far ahead the tile looks: 7, 14 or 30 days from today.
